myDiaries.originalText: 你好今天是面試完的第一天，昨天面試因為準備的有些倉促

myWords.sentence: Could I borrow your pen for a moment?

sentences: Make sure the pineapple smells sweet at the bottom before you buy it. | 在購買鳳梨之前，請確保它的底部聞起來香甜。
The local farm offers guided tours showing visitors how pineapples are grown and harvested. | 這間當地農場提供導覽服務，向遊客展示鳳梨是如何種植與採收的。
We decided to discuss the new project details over afternoon tea. | 我們決定在下午茶時間討論新專案的細節。
Are you coming to the party tonight? | 你今晚會來參加派對嗎？
I make it by myself | 這個是我自己做的
My grandmother taught me how to make fresh pasta from scratch. | 我祖母教我如何從零開始手做新鮮義大利麵。
He spent the whole weekend making a wooden bookshelf for his bedroom. | 他花了整個週末親手為他的臥室做了一個木製書架。
He spent the whole weekend making a wooden bookshelf for his bedroom. | 他花了整個週末親手為他的臥室做了一個木製書架。
How are you? |
My mother is the gentlest person. | 我的媽媽是最溫柔的人
Excuse me, Mr./Ms. [老師姓氏], I won't be able to make it to class tomorrow. | 老師我明天想請假
He's the closest thing to an angel I've ever met. | 他是我見過最像天使的人了
Hello, it's so good to see you again! | 你好，很高興能夠再次見到你
hello.....
Mom, please! I really want to go to the dance. | 拜託媽媽，我是真的想去那個舞會
Just keep running—I’ll handle the rest | 你只需要向前跑，我會幫你善後
She had to run to catch the last bus. | 她必須用跑的才能趕上最後一班公車。
The air conditioner has been running all day. | 冷氣已經開了一整天。
Mom, can we go play over there? | 媽媽我們可以去那邊玩嗎
There's a splendid view from the top of the mountain | 山頂俯瞰，美景盡收眼底
We had a splendid time at the beach yesterday. | 我們昨天在海邊度過了極佳
Yes, let's go for a walk! What a splendid idea. | 好呀！我們去散步吧！真是個好主意
Her bag looked old and worn | 她的包包看起來又破又舊

myWords.wordNote: 是wear的過去式
con-一起、共同；-crete 拉丁文代表生長，所以就是一起凝固的意思，且代表名詞「水泥」,就像水泥凝固後變成堅實的混泥土一樣

sentences: We can't charge him without some concrete evidence. | 我們沒有確鑿的證據，我們不能起訴他

myWords.wordNote: 使...行動起來

sentences: Please enter your four digit code to activate your card. | 請輸入四位數字密碼以啟用您的卡片

myWords.wordNote: ad(朝向)+sist(站立)=站到旁邊，引申為「幫助」、「協助」

sentences: This is Emily. She assists us with day-to-day errands and tasks. | 這是Emily，他協助我們處理日常事務和工作
I work in sales, but I also sometimes assist our company's marketing team. | 我從事行銷工作，但我也有時協助公司的行銷團隊
If you pay for dinner, I'll buy the tickets. Does that seem fair? | 如果你付飯錢，我就來買票，你覺得這樣公平嗎？
There's a career fair tomorrow. I strongly urge all of you to attend. | 明天有一個職業博覽會，我強烈督促大家都去參加

myWords.wordNote: 相似詞:copy

sentences: Children imitate their parents, so be careful what you say and do. | 孩子會模仿他們的父母，所以要小心你的言行
Children often imitate the behavior of the adults around them. | 孩子們經常模仿身邊成年人的行為。
She tried to imitate her mentor's professional demeanor during the presentation. | 她在簡報過程中試圖效仿導師的專業風範。
The comedian can imitate the voices of famous politicians perfectly. | 這位喜劇演員能完美地模仿著名政治人物的聲音。

myWords.wordNote: in-「進入」、it-「走去」、ate-「動詞結尾」=「走進去開始」，introduce(介紹，帶進去)，exit(出口，走出去)

meanings.concept: 啟動、發起、開始(針對主動發起和創立)
sentences: The school initiated a new after-school volunteer program. | 學校開始了一項新的課後志願活動
The company initiated a new sustainability program to reduce its environmental impact. | 這間公司主動發起了一項新的永續計畫，以減少對環境的影響。
The government initiated a series of economic reforms to boost local businesses. | 政府主動啟動了一連串的經濟改革，以振興在地企業。

meanings.concept: 表達對於過去發生的事情合理推斷
sentences: The homework must have been too hard for him. | 作業對他來說肯定太難了
He must have forgotten to bring his text book. | 他肯定忘了帶課本

myWords.wordNote: con-眾人、solt-解決=向外求助(諮詢、查閱)

sentences: Please consult our website for more details. | 詳情請查閱我們的網站
If you are not sure how to assemble the furniture, please consult the manual. | 如果你不確定如何組裝這套家具，請參考說明書。
She had to consult the map several times to find the correct path. | 她必須多次查閱地圖才能找到正確的路。
You should consult a lawyer before signing any legal contract. | 在簽署任何法律合約之前，你應該先諮詢律師。
I need to consult with my team before making a final decision on this project. | 在對這個專案做出最終決定之前，我需要先與我的團隊進行協商。
If your symptoms persist, you should consult a doctor as soon as possible. | 如果你的症狀持續存在，應該儘快諮詢醫生。

myWords.wordNote: con-一起、-cept把東西抓住，ac(向)cept=accept接受

sentences: Death is a difficult concept for kids to understand. | 對孩子來說，死亡是個難以理解的概念
It is difficult for young children to understand the concept of time. | 年幼的孩子很難理解時間的概念。
The team spent months developing the concept for the new project. | 團隊花了數個月的時間來開發這個新專案的概念。

myWords.wordNote: con-一起，-vert 轉動、轉變/revert=恢復

sentences: They converted the farmhouse into a small church | 他們把農舍改建成一座小教堂
Let's convert this room into an office | 我們把這個房間轉換成辦公室吧
Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity to power the house. | 太陽能板將陽光轉換成電能來為房屋提供電力。
I need to convert this PDF file into a Word document so I can edit it. | 我需要將這個 PDF 檔案轉換成 Word 文件，這樣我才能進行編輯。

myWords.wordNote: 針對某種進度去做加速、或變快

sentences: Heavy smoking can accelerate the aging process | 過度吸菸會加速衰老
The company decided to accelerate its project to meet the deadline | 公司決定加速計畫以趕上截止日期
The company decided to accelerate the development of its new product. | 這間公司決定加快新產品的開發進度。
The driver pressed the gas pedal to accelerate the car. | 司機踩下油門以加快車速。
The government implemented new policies to accelerate economic growth. | 政府實施了新政策以加速經濟成長。

myWords.wordNote: （不及物動詞）人為開頭的句子不能用

sentences: Economic growth may stagnate if consumers stop spending | 如果消費者停止消費，經濟成長可能停滯不前
Wages in this country have stagnated | 這個國家的薪資停滯不前
The local economy began to stagnate after the main factory closed down. | 在主要工廠關閉後，當地的經濟開始陷入停滯。
Sales figures have stagnated over the past two quarters due to weak market demand. | 由於市場需求疲軟，銷售額在過去兩個季度一直處於停滯狀態。
We've had to halt all work until this permit problem is resolved | 我們不得不停止所有工作，直到這個許可證問題解決為止
The unexpected strike forced the company to halt production at the main factory. | 突如其來的罷工迫使該公司中斷總廠的生產。
A lack of funding effectively halted the research project before it could begin. | 資金短缺使得該研究計畫在開始前就陷入中斷。
The whole town has come to a halt because of the snowstorm | 因為暴風雪，整個小鎮陷入了停頓

myWords.wordNote: 縮短流程的加速，使流程更快

meanings.concept: 加速 + pes(腳)幫忙解開腳鐐好做事
sentences: We can expedite your visa application for an additional fee | 我們可以幫你加急處理for你支付的額外費用
Is there anyway to expedite the process? | 有任何辦法可以加速流程嗎？
We need to expedite the review process so the project can move forward without delays. | 我們需要加速審查流程，好讓專案順利推進而不致延誤。
The company agreed to expedite the shipment to make up for the previous delay. | 公司同意加速貨物的運送，以彌補之前的延誤。
Providing all required documents in advance will help expedite your visa application. | 提前提供所有所需文件將有助於加速您的簽證申請。

myWords.wordNote: In-內在 ，cent-歌頌（accent ），ive 名詞或形容詞的結尾

sentences: The government offers incentives to encourage people to have children | 政府提出獎勵政策來鼓勵人們生育
The company offers a cash incentive to employees who exceed their sales targets. | 公司提供現金獎勵給超越銷售目標的員工。
A bonus extra day off was given as an incentive for completing the project early. | 提前完成專案獲得了一天額外假期作為獎勵。

myWords.wordNote: 通常前面會加the ,the latest 最高級

sentences: The latest design features a beautiful flower patten | 最新的設計採用美麗的花朵為特色
She always has the latest phone | 他總是擁有最新款的手機
Have you heard the latest news about the project? | 你聽說關於這個計畫的最新消息了嗎？
You can download the latest version of the app for free. | 你可以免費下載這款應用程式的最新版本。
The latest report shows a significant increase in sales this month. | 最新報告顯示本月的銷售額有大幅度的增加。

myWords.wordNote: As =[如同、像…一樣］if =[如果/假設]，等於as though=[雖然、假設]

sentences: He talks as if he knows everything about the project. | 他說話的樣子好像他知道這個專案的一切。
It looks as if it's going to rain soon. | 天氣看起來好像快要下雨了。
She treated me as if I were a complete stranger. | 她對待我的方式好像我是個陌生人一樣。

myWords.wordNote: It is provided that...（被提供了……作為條件）

sentences: You can borrow my car provided you return it before midnight. | 只要你在午夜前歸還，你就可以借我的車。
We will go on a picnic tomorrow, provided the weather stays nice. | 只要天氣保持晴朗，我們明天就去野餐。
He agreed to lead the project, provided he gets the necessary budget. | 只要能獲得必要的預算，他就同意領導這個專案。
Another interview? We need the exposure to promote your book ! | 又要採訪? 我需要曝光來宣傳你的書
She's researching the internet's influence on social relations. | 他正在研究網路對社會關係的影響
My boss has a great influence on the school board. | 我老闆對學校董事會有很大的影響力
Parents have a profound influence on their children's character. | 父母對孩子的性格有著深遠的影響。
Social media can greatly influence people's purchasing decisions | 社群媒體能極大地影響人們的購買決定
A good teacher can influence a student's entire life. | 一位好老師能影響學生的一生

myWords.wordNote: re-在後面+main(停留)+der(做的東西)=剩下的部分

sentences: He spent the remainder of the war in a POW camp | 他在戰俘營裡度過了戰爭剩下的時間

myWords.wordNote: con-「一起」+dit-「說」+tion「名詞結尾」=一起說好的事情

sentences: If you offer more flexible payment conditions, we will agree to place an order next week. | 如果你們可以提供更有彈性的付款條件，我們就會同意下週就下訂單
OK, you can use it, but under one condition | 好，你可以用，但有個條件
They agreed to sign the contract under one condition. | 他們同意簽署合約，但有一個條件。
You must strictly follow all the terms and conditions of this agreement. | 你必須嚴格遵守本協議的所有條款與約定。
She accepted the job offer on condition that she could work remotely. | 她接受了這份工作邀請，條件是她可以遠端辦公。
There's not much in the way of entertainment in this town - just the cinema and a couple of pubs. | 這個城鎮沒多少娛樂活動——也就只有這家影院和幾家酒館。
It looks like we're going to have some pre-dinner entertainment. | 看來我們要進行餐前餘興節目了
The hotel provides live entertainment, including music and magic shows, for its guests every weekend. | 這間飯店每週末都會為住客提供包含音樂與魔術秀的現場娛樂表演。
We hired a local jazz band to provide the entertainment for the party. | 我們聘請了一支在地爵士樂團來為派對提供娛樂表演。

myWords.wordNote: 代表三個、少數幾個

meanings.concept: a couple of hours 表達「幾天/幾個小時」
sentences: I just need a couple of hours to double-check the figures. I’ll send it to you before 5 PM. | 我只需要幾個小時來複查數字，下午五點前會寄給你。

meanings.concept: a couple of bucks 表達「幾塊錢/幾張紙鈔」
sentences: A: Oh no, my total is $12, but I only have a ten-dollar bill./B: Don't worry! I have a couple of bucks in my pocket. Here you go. | （糟糕，總共 12 塊，但我只有一張十元鈔票。）別擔心！我口袋裡有幾塊錢（零錢），拿去吧。

meanings.concept: a couple of key points 表達「幾個重點/幾句對話」
sentences: Before we start, I’d like to share a couple of key points with you. | 在我們開始前，我想先跟你分享幾個核心重點。
Who took the lead in sales last month? | 誰在上個月的銷售業績中取得了領先？
The runner accelerated in the final lap and managed to take the lead. | 這名跑者在最後一圈加速，成功取得了領先。
Our company took the lead in the smart home market by releasing innovative products. | 我們公司透過推出創新產品，在智慧家居市場中取得領先地位。

myWords.wordNote: divide(分開)+-sion(名詞型)=分割

sentences: She's the new head of the East Asia division | 他是東亞分部的新負責人
She was recently promoted to head of the marketing division. | 她最近被升為行銷部門的主管。
The company decided to open a new division in Asia to handle local sales. | 這間公司決定在亞洲成立一個新分部來負責當地的銷售業務。
Our research and development division works closely with the production team. | 我們的研發部門與生產團隊緊密合作。
I bought it solely for that purpose. | 我僅僅是爲那個目的才買的
It seems he's not solely to blame for the accident. | 發生這起事故似乎不能只責怪他
The product's success cannot be attributable solely to the ads. | 該産品的成功不能只歸因於廣告宣傳
She is solely responsible for the success of this project. | 她要獨自為這個專案的成功負全責。
This facility is used solely for medical research. | 這間設施僅供醫療研究使用。
You shouldn't make a decision based solely on emotion. | 你不應該僅憑情緒就做出決定。

myWords.wordNote: anonymous

sentences: The donation was made anonymously. | 捐贈是匿名進行的
The information was posted anonymously online. | 該信息以匿名方式發布在網上
He donated a large sum of money to the charity anonymously. | 他匿名向該慈善機構捐贈了一大筆錢。
Employees can submit their feedback anonymously through an online survey. | 員工可以透過線上問卷匿名提交他們的意見。

myWords.wordNote: at-朝向，tempt嘗試=朝...嘗試

sentences: Please don't attempt to cut your own hair ever again | 請不要再嘗試自己剪頭髮了
The corporation is relentless in its attempts to acquire a monopoly of the tourist industry in this area | 該企業努力不懈在它的企圖上去取得該地區的壟斷觀光

myWords.wordNote: 原指飛行員用降落傘緊急逃生，government bailout 常與政府綁在一起

sentences: Three years of huge losses forced the bank to seek a government bailout. | 長達三年的巨額虧損迫使銀行向政府尋求援助
The government provided a multi-billion dollar bailout to prevent the major bank from collapsing. | 政府提供了數十億美元的經濟救助，以防止這家大型銀行倒閉。
Many taxpayers opposed the government bailout of large corporations during the financial crisis. | 在金融危機期間，許多納稅人反對政府對大型企業進行經濟救助。
Without an emergency financial bailout, the struggling airline would have gone bankrupt. | 若沒有緊急的經濟救助，這家陷入困境的航空公司原本會面臨破產。
Even with a tight budget, we managed to host a wonderful party. | 即使預算有限，我們還是辦到了舉辦一場美好的派對。
I don't know how he manages to stay so positive under so much pressure. | 我不知道他怎麼辦到在這麼大的壓力下還能保持如此積極。
Despite the terrible traffic, she managed to arrive at the airport on time. | 儘管交通狀況很糟糕，她還是辦到了準時趕到機場。
It's not easy to manage an entire department. | 管理整個部門並不容易

myWords.wordNote: re-相反，sign做標記，ation名詞型式=辭職

sentences: You should think twice before tendering your letter of resignation | 在遞交辭職信之前，你應該三思而後行
After months of consideration, she finally handed in her letter of resignation yesterday. | 經過幾個月的考慮，她終於在昨天遞交了辭職信。
The CEO announced his sudden resignation during the emergency board meeting. | 執行長在緊急董事會會議上宣布了他突然辭職的消息。
The manager accepted his resignation and wished him the best in his future career. | 經理接受了他的辭職，並祝福他未來的事業順利。

myWords.wordNote: pro-向前，-mote移動=促進

sentences: The company launched a social media campaign to promote its new product line. | 這間公司發起了社群媒體活動來宣傳其新產品線。
They hired a famous influencer to promote their brand on Instagram. | 他們聘請了一位知名網紅在 Instagram 上宣傳他們的品牌。
We are offering special discounts this weekend to promote our new store opening. | 我們本週末提供特別優惠，以促銷新店開幕。

myWords.wordNote: expand into + foreign market / overseas

sentences: The tech company plans to expand into the European market next year. | 這家科技公司計劃明年進軍歐洲市場。
Our business needs to expand into new retail channels to boost sales. | 我們的業務需要進軍新的零售通路，以提升銷售額。
After achieving success domestically, the brand decided to expand overseas. | 在國內取得成功後，該品牌決定擴大規模進軍海外。

myWords.wordNote: de-離開，riv-流動=引出、衍生出

sentences: The income is derived from her investments. | 這筆收入衍生自她的投資
She derives great satisfaction from her job. | 她從工作中獲得極大的滿足感
After Linda took an early retirement, she lived a life of luxury off the income derived from her investment. | 在琳達提早退休之後，她過著奢華的生活，靠著收入從她的投資中所獲得的

myWords.wordNote: ac-朝...方向+com-一起，及物動詞

sentences: Will you accompany me to the dance? | 你能陪我去跳舞嗎?
My best friend offered to accompany me to the job interview. | 我最好的朋友主動提議陪我去參加求職面試。
Children under twelve must be accompanied by an adult. | 十二歲以下的兒童必須由大人陪同。
I would be happy to accompany you to the doctor tomorrow. | 我明天很樂意陪你看醫生。

myWords.wordNote: 可以用來形容淡淡的

sentences: a faint sound | 微弱的聲音
a faint glow | 微弱的光
She gave me a faint smile of recognition. | 她認出了我，向我淡淡一笑
There's not the faintest hope of ever finding him. | 沒有絲毫找到他的希望
When people are faced with challenges, some people thrive while others can't handle the pressure. | 當人們被面臨 / 遭遇挑戰時，有些人能蓬勃發展，有些人則無法承受壓力
Faced with challenges, some people thrive while others can't handle the pressure. |

myWords.wordNote: over在上面往下看+see看=監督

sentences: As the project manager, she will oversee the daily operations of the team. | 作為專案經理，她將監督團隊的日常運作。
The senior engineer was hired to oversee the construction of the new bridge. | 這位資深工程師被聘來監督新橋樑的施工。

myWords.wordNote: ad-方向，dict-說=朝某個方向把自己交出去 I'm addicted to XXX.

sentences: Tobacco is highly addictive | 煙草極易使人上癮
The problem with video games is that they're addictive. | 電子遊戲的問題在於它們會使人上癮
These nuts are addictive - I can't stop eating them. | 這些堅果讓人上癮，我一吃就停不了口
He reviewed his options before making a final decision. | 他在最後作出決定之前，對各種選擇進行了斟酌權衡
